name: ERPNext Iran Settings
description: Empty values fall back to the same key in site_config.json.

fields.label: VAT Rate (%)
fields.description: Used by the Iran VAT tax templates. Check the current legal rate; existing templates are not changed.

fields.label: Use Persian Digits (۰۱۲۳)
fields.description: Shows numbers in lists, reports and read-only values with Persian digits. Inputs and stored values stay 0-9. For print formats use the persian_digits filter.

fields.label: Cheque Accounts
fields.description: Per company. Empty accounts fall back to the account numbers of the Iran chart of accounts (110402, 110401, 210201).

fields.label: Dollar Rate (Rial per 1 USD)
fields.description: Saved as the Currency Exchange rate of today, USD to IRR and USD to IRT. There is no automatic source: enter the rate you use, and again when it changes.

fields.options: Adds a series with the Jalali year (ACC-SINV-1405-00001) to the sales, purchase and payment documents and makes it the default. Existing series and documents are not changed; the new series counts from 1.

fields.label: Label Prefix
fields.description: The first digit(s) of a label printed by the scale. Most scales use 2.

fields.label: Weight or Price Digits
fields.description: Prefix, PLU and these digits must be 12 together; the 13th is the check digit.

fields.label: Weight Divisor
fields.description: Weight on the label in grams and the item sold in kilograms: 1000. Ignored when the label carries a price.

fields.label: Max Share of an Invoice Payable with Points (%)
fields.description: At most this part of an invoice may be paid with club points, so a customer cannot take everything as a discount. 100 means no limit. Checked on the POS and again when the invoice is saved.
